alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A pink background. A small black receipt printer at the top prints a long white paper strip, one line at a time, while a Cella with a small red crown, standing in a white circle of light, reads it with her eyes. Title: RECEIPT, We should hang out. Lines: Said it: 5 times. Days proposed: 0. Calendars opened: 0. Sincerity: 100%. At the last line she leans back, offended and proud. TOTAL: 1 coffee, someday, in bigger letters, and a red stamp says PENDING at the top right corner of the paper. A second, indigo Cella, who has been lifting a cardboard phone at her side, leans into a paper cup and slides it along the floor until it sits next to the crowned Cella. Both look at the camera: Pick a day?
envio: the friend you keep telling "we should hang out"
